conformal_calibration.method_label: AD-stratified Empirical-Bayes shrunk interval (empirically calibrated on nested 5-fold OOF residuals; not an exact finite-sample conformal guarantee)
conformal_calibration.deployment_policy_note: Engineering trade-off for pure-JSON zero-dependency serving: nested-OOF selected mondrian_ad_eb on 48/80 tracks (baseline 13, studentized_cvplus 11, cqr_lgb 8); deployed uniformly across all 80 regression tracks with holdout coverage reported identically from mondrian_ad_eb. Note: cqr_lgb achieved higher overall holdout coverage (79.2%/91.0% dual, min 52.2%) at the cost of .joblib/LightGBM runtime artifacts.

mt46_deep_transfer.reason: Deferred after independent audit flagged post-hoc holdout filtering and unified-vs-per-endpoint train-serve mismatch; all 46 endpoints preserve strict OOF-selected Wave 5A point weights (0.0 diff).

gnn_atom_attribution.architecture: Pure-PyTorch 4-Layer E-GATv2 + Task-Specific WeightAndSum (visualizes the 0.35*y_add residual branch; main predictions come from the 4-FM super-ensemble)

step2a_censored_logit_diagnostic.finding: TobitKernelEM / Logit-Tobit breaks the ~0.72 linear PPB ceiling on lipidated GLP-1s and reduces censored Hinge MAE on cytotoxicity_CC50/MIC_E_faecalis/MIC_S_aureus/MBC_S_aureus, with minor exact-subset MAE trade-off; kept diagnostic while main models stay exact-optimal.

v335_protocol_audit.promotion_rule: 100% ZERO-HOLDOUT-PEEKING: Promote expanded existing endpoint ONLY if 5-seed nested CV paired MAE improves by >=1.0% (and >=0.005) on identical baseline CV rows AND 5-seed mean CV Spearman >= -0.01 AND >=4/5 seeds improve. Holdout is NEVER inspected for accept/reject.

delta_logd_experimental_validation.protocol: Strictly Out-of-Sample: LogD7.4_OOS - LogD_decadiene_5x5_OOF vs Measured (LogD_oct - LogD_dec)
delta_logd_experimental_validation.scope_warning: Validated exclusively on cyclic macrocycles; ΔLogD for linear non-macrocyclic peptides is extrapolated and flagged out-of-scope.

v335_protocol_audit.deep_mt_note: Deep Multi-Task checkpoints (3 legacy winners: F, CL_absolute, Cmax) were not retrained in v33.5; newly promoted endpoints use CPU/4-FM Fusion only.
v335_protocol_audit.clinical_pk_index_license: US Federal Government Public Domain (FDA DailyMed SPL & Drugs@FDA NDA/BLA Reviews, 17 U.S.C. § 105) — 59 drugs, 427 PK records; zero CC-BY-NC mirroring.

logd_decadiene_delta_validation.protocol: Cluster-grouped LOCO CV (max_inter_cluster_tanimoto=0.8438, not strict series isolation; train_cpu_track LOCO MAE=0.5652, Spearman=0.8667, R2=0.7607; Naylor LPE 2018 primary SI octanol values; 5 clusters, exploratory CI)
logd_decadiene_delta_validation.cluster_boot_caveat: Only 5 clusters represented; cluster bootstrap CI is wide and exploratory.
logd_decadiene_delta_validation.scope_warning: Validated strictly on cyclic macrocycles within-series (LOCO); ΔLogD for linear/non-macrocyclic peptides is extrapolated and badges are hidden.

v335_protocol_audit.evidence_grade_policy: CI-aware grading: regression `quantitative` requires n_ho>=30, n_clusters>=10, R2>=0.15, R2_ci95_lo>0, Spearman>=0.45, and uq_reliability!=low; negative R2 & Spearman flagged `exploratory_not_recommended`.
